## Design

### 2026-10-12 – Designing and making the swords:

**1.2h**

Designing and making the swords:

So the first about maling a bifurcated sword is that it needs to have a minimum of two components with ridges or grooves to join them both,based on that simple concept I made this design

![IMG_20261012_235841](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/848af05fe6739166d3ab42decf42bf00647d26a2ef1a79cda083dd2b61b5839a.jpg)

It's very basic,but will work for now. Maybe I'll need another smaller sword later for some extra stability but thas for later.

After that I started making the design on Onshape, now due to the fact that it needs precise,symmetric measurements it took some time to make,after that had to look up on the dimensions of swords to get the measurements right {mostly, nothing is adjusted to scale yet}.
The basic design is seen below

![Screenshot 2026-10-12 211559](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/c90ebedf2e1c656f48a0df796d7743fe399c9330df82e4a0d1c49e61ebadece3.png)

Now this is only one half of the blade,and the hilt and handle still need some work done so that the sword can fit properly and several grooves need to made to allow it to merge.

But so far it's a pretty decent start to the project! No issues so far, probably cause conceptually it's very simple, execution wise, I'll find out as it goes I suppose

### 2026-10-14 – Made actual progress today.

**3h**

Made actual progress today.
So i took a sample image of  a sword to use which was much needed. So before I could split the sword, its probably better to make the combined bigger sword first then split it and based on this train of thought I started working

![16609785585156](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/cac9a953fb5a4b1c62758d75475ed4c339c563cff70bdc65aa6872d370ecc92b.png)
This is the sword I took as reference.

![Screenshot 2026-10-14 194659](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/5fd312db1363c93044dca5c9d091eebe44e019cc553b340320a26ee74cd34a60.png)
It took me some time to realize "Hey you can import images to Onshape" and after realizing that imported the image to draw over it.After that after I drew over the sword, I realized I messed up the outlining of the hilt. So had to redo that. So the final sketch I got was

![Screenshot 2026-10-14 202159](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/a2eef2149b0f661298f255d873849c61e83b20ec669ac44f64a9cf56a4267f7e.png)
This took me too long to do. Then after that I extended the layer and got the 3D sword finally,whcih turned out fine I thought, but then i realized I should probably split it into parts (I'll have to split it again into parts for 3D printing,since my sword technically is a longsword, but for now this is fine)

![Screenshot 2026-10-14 201102](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/18604dbf22b0f91cc2fc5d93e4b471098aa6347c8dcd40cbffe59791ee70f415.png)

(This is the image taken after i figured out splitting)
So the main challenge I faced today was Splitting my sword, I initially thought i might be able to just split it in the sketch but that wasn't possible( I tried),so I had to split it in the 3d  extruded part itself which took Waaaay too long honestly (Thas  where half of these hours come from).
After some googling I realized you can use planes perpendicular to the sword then split it, and so I added the planes then set an offset to them so they're at the hilt, but as seen in one of the images above,the sword I took was placed diagonally on the axis, the first extrusion was also made diagonally then, which means the split would be horrible, and so it took me some time to move and rotate the sword.

After that I made two planes (seen in the 3D sword image i sent) and then i set the offsets and split it into several parts, due to some poor sketching some of the hilt had to be cut off, so the hilt looks flat at two points but thas acceptable honestly. And so the final split parts came out to be

![Screenshot 2026-10-14 201743](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/dea0e0c626b81f402701d5aaf53e36ea0b9db7cac28ac17ae1366553734c8e8e.png)

TLDR: Decided to use a reference sword. Made a big sword first to split into swords later. Realized I needed to split it into blade,hilt,handle to make the printing easier, due to  idiocy, couldn't do it, so shifted sword along an axis, rotated it and finally managed to split it into separate parts.

### 2026-10-15 – Today was all about Transformations and splitting.

**1.8h**

Today was all about Transformations and splitting.
So today I planned to split the words which was now easier since i knew how to split it already thanks to the mess that was yesterday. But the issue today was aligning the parts to split stuff, now in the previous pics its probably seen that most if not all the parts are of axis slightly,which turned out to be an issue

![Screenshot 2026-10-16 000620](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/38fbb3fa34dba4243eb82089c0a2ce6a15b2be961e610af72f809a4371f6e8aa.png)
(This is the most painful and obvious example)
So one quick google search the solution turned out to be Transformations. Now unlike the Robots in disguise, This turned out to be much more simple, but somewhat annoying. Each part needed its own transformations to somewhat be properly aligned to splitting.Now this led to a solid hour and a 20 min of just aligning everything to split it.Which shows as

![Screenshot 2026-10-16 003817](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/8687b5a0f644699a25a8f13f386758013fc58f27c7bce1c3b69dfe340eafa67d.png)
(Yes there are 10 Transformations)

And so after all that Transforming,1. I wanted to see Transformers Prime again, and 2.I got everything properly aligned.And then I moved on to the Easy part of Splitting!

![Screenshot 2026-10-16 001049](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/c696649a9ff78e52a5f99ef8545215b981e1c789dbd4b32327f865bff22190cc.png)

This took line 15min since I had to align some planes a bit to split stuff but still exponentially less time than yesterday.Then I moved on to the assembling

![Screenshot 2026-10-16 001945](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/cf17b11e4289dd1048f0a023a9d9edc8dd4face7de1893f1beffef031691442b.png)
(Incredibly satisfying)
Finally after spending several min assembling em together I got:

![Screenshot 2026-10-16 002822](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/a72016ac6d392e4d51ecc945f9c5bc9e53cbbf08d9eb803f59909b99667b6db4.png)

And now I'm about halfway done, just gotta make the ridges and holes for joining the two swords together ,and probably some for each part of the blade to make it easier to Print (I want my sword to be decently long). But halfway done les goo!!!

Tldr:Goal was to split swords, Did many probably inefficient transformations (Total=10) and got everything aligned  properly, managed to split the sword into two smaller swords and assembled them together to see if it would fit properly.(It does{99%})

### 2026-10-17 – Today's goal was making em splitable, and much like a good divorce lawyer FINALLY DID IT!

**1.5h**

Today's goal was making em splitable, and much like a good divorce lawyer FINALLY DID IT!
So to do that I decided to add ridges and holes to do so, Soon realizing I had to do that for both the sword and hilt, not for the handle tho.

So after some sketching and measuring,managed to make these on the sword

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 133752](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/49c9484515b02181b1123610bf2b5a1f86d113c8b41ae0afb30d70b25e5bee9d.png)
Now I realized after this,hey! the grooves are exactly of equal dimensions so no way are they gonna fit exactly, so then spent a few minutes just tweaking the dimensions of the holes to make em slightly bigger.

The I did the same process for the hilt,but did not repeat the mistake this time

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 133811](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/3138df9c4dd80aae416ad2c7b798c7ee6ce5dccdbfcbe992f743659d9de7ffac.png)

And  then Assembled it all together to see if it fits or not,and yup it doess!!!

![image_2026-10-17_135017155](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/e30da0fe7ceae3627eb6a6742a32b1b1458e68fd6bf58b778e12ac1d9dab5790.png)

Tldr:Added grooves and ridges to make the swords attach together and split up, Got the dimensions of the hole wrong, then corrected it and now it all fits.

### 2026-10-17 – Made design changes and several other changes.SO:

**2h**

Made design changes and several other changes.SO:
Prior to everything, I learnt You can add color to the parts, so I made the blade red, the hilt gold and the handle black.Then,
First thing is I decided to make the holes and small openings and ridges much bigger, much like the original design shown a while back. but after making the sword I realized this isn't quite what I intended so I made the holes much bigger.

![image_2026-10-17_173348924](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/aa799e0ea04cf25ed6403ee6a237a750bc11b8970a024f978aebfaaa2df25cdb.png)
Now the sword looked much more like the original design, then i made the holes slightly wider than the ridges so that it would fit in.This was easier now since I only had 1 dimension to worry about since the whole blade would get hollowed out.
Then I made the blade thinner, which took a long time to do since I didn't know how until I asked Claude on what to do, After learning that Move face exists, adjusting the blade to be thinner without just breaking apart took some time. But finally after a stupidly long time, got the blade thinner.

![image_2026-10-17_173952244](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/a72b9a40096925a4f9239ecc0832a80857893cf8cda88acac3cce8db187ff0fd.png)

Second, I wanted a pretty long sword so I decided to Scale up the sword, then I thought No shot this is printable in one go, and so I decided to split the blade and handle, which turned out to be the longest parts.
I considered that the printer used to print this probably has limits of 18x18x18cm,so using that as a scale I adjusted the splits, and after doing several splits,I couldn't tell what was for what so I named all the parts

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 170533](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/f1b0bcbd0ea9782cf40b8a13bc32c356a84bdac312ec73278796014ae4784beb.png)
After that I tested if everything fits or not when its all together, which I did in assembly mode and after some jigsaw puzzling I got

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 170457](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/eb486d9ea90ff7cdb2bce08a6086b022acfa16b68a55b19bdb61639086507c97.png)

![image_2026-10-17_174527535](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/565eb7fe8add20261bcdb3989532ea5b075d7c0d86a4dfa4190cba2a53f2886f.png)
And so the blades fit perfectly, I decided to remove the hole and ridge in the hilt since it seemed pointless. The handle also doesn't need a hole and ridge since it'll affect the grip. I thought of making the blade taper but realized that it will probably lead tome stabbing someone or myself so I didn't

TLDR; Remade the entire blade to suit the original design more, Made the width of the blade smaller so that its more like a sword than a hammer, Added color to the whole sword, Split the sword into 18 Parts totally so that its actually possible to 3D print

### 2026-10-18 – Today I decided to add an additional dagger alongside the sword.

**1.7h**

Today I decided to add an additional dagger alongside the sword.
The dagger was necessary because 1.Its cool, 2.Added stability when attached to the sword.
I decided to base the design of the dagger on the one from Solo Leveling, which I used as a reference image.

![Screenshot 2026-10-19 003921](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/ec4b0e5048887029e8eda0e5f0b3b7bd211df491105ce9b32d2e60f29bbf0f33.png)
I roughly traced over it and a somewhat similar design for the blade. The drawing part took some time mainly because of some of the curves of the dagger didn't allow the spline lines to go properly so had to use a mix of spline and straight lines. After which I had learnt from my previous mistake from the Sword, so I made each part of the dagger (i.e. the handle, blade, hilt) a separate sketch and extruded them separately. This allowed me to tweak their dimensions and width much better than I could with the sword(Since it all came from 1 common extrude).
After extruding it and scaling it up I realized an issue.

![Screenshot 2026-10-19 004712](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/f556ca028477a7d351a8dc47441124bf21293be1770b157bdd655c543483f006.png)
It was too long(I was working under the basis of 18x18x18cm) so I decided to split the blade part of it since it was the only one too long.

![Screenshot 2026-10-19 005024](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/531357a1331fbfc5b7bb78845f6dc81c25b0e507317459e5678f2a828ab66560.png)
After adjusting the planes and splitting and scaling again, I faced the same issue again i.e. the BLADE WAS TOO LONG!!

![Screenshot 2026-10-19 005628](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/21b60f240f67c934319a799d29b5d581c1d76bc3b708e29a944ef4d9766c2379.png)
So despite my frustration, I decided to split it a bit better this time. Since the top part was only about 11cm or so, I decided to move the split more downwards so that both would be somewhat equal and the result was pretty good.

![Screenshot 2026-10-19 010209](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/923a5f52b863fe10e195f6f0d336f87987129cfb1fcfcf3dc013465a0f44fd40.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-19 010041](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/2c0a28bc1e7c2199974fd741aeb1dbd2379f93a76c53dc6f778f54dd1677556e.png)
The line is a bit curved but approximately from tip to the split part, it is 18cm.After that i saw how it assembled up with the sword.

![Screenshot 2026-10-19 010414](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/Aak0Y0a0ppmv3RPoHNE55PGI9i4P30aq/947d501ec21393bb9b57cdced3c595890beb4322bdd074991f32ed8c7a8de3c0.png)
Then spent several minutes uploading to GitHub in a format that accepts color.

And with this, I'm Finally DONE WITH THIS WEEK'S PROJECT!!It was really fun making something on my own for once.
